expected: After a prune removed the cached mirror and kept its records, a live empty payload on its config topic deletes both records of that device from the local Store at once, keeps the other device's record, lists only that device and publishes nothing.
actual: The local Store still holds all three rows after the tombstone (AssertionError at the first post-tombstone assertion; left has the two records of the tombstoned device plus the other one): the sync tombstone path returns early because the id is no mirror any more, and the manager removal never touches local records.

The failure comes from the missing destructive path, not from setup or import. In the same run the live-tombstone test failed on the same assertion and the manager-seam test failed on the ImportError of the planned MirrorRemovalCause API (that one is not the target).
